infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: This app needs access to your camera to take photos of civic issues.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: This app needs access to your photo library to select images of civic issues.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: This app needs access to your location to tag the location of civic issues.

plugins.photosPermission: The app accesses your photos to let you share them with your civic reports.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow CivicMobile to use your location to tag issue locations.
